name: Player leaves a bridge supported by a stationary four-cell pedestal
description:
The player shares support of box 2 with stationary box 0, a four-cell pedestal resting on Floor. Walking north moves only the player. Both boxes must remain in place. Pedestal support must behave the same for one cube and for a larger polycube; unlike an interlocking clasp, this pedestal is independently supported and does not rest on the bridge.

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (1, 2, 1); Box 2: 4 cells, starting at (1, 2, 2) through (2, 3, 2); Box 0: 4 cells, starting at (2, 2, 1) through (3, 3, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
